page.overview:
Who is Black Jens?

Black Jens is a Ghoul and the chief courtier and chancellor of the Vampire Lord Luthor Harkon of the Zombie Pirates who rules the Vampire Coast of Lustria.

When in his right mind and not suffering from his frequent bouts of insanity, the Vampire Lord Luthor Harkon governs the Vampire Coast directly, receiving reports and giving orders, interviewing the occasional ambassador from the Druchii or powerful visitors from the Old World, and scheming to break the power of the Slann over Lustria. Though relations with the Lizardmen and their mage-priest rulers are hostile, Harkon is rumoured to maintain connections to the Great Clans of Sylvania through contacts in the Border Princes, as well as having dealings with unknown powers in Grand Cathay.

When not in his "right mind," something that happens with increasing frequency, Harkon relies on his courtiers. A mixed coterie of intelligent Undead and mortal Men, all held in thrall by Harkon's will, chief among them is "Black Jens," a Ghoul and his chancellor. When Harkon is away or unable to govern, it is Jens who gives the orders in "the Emperor's" name.

Once the captain of the ship that conveyed Harkon to Lustria, Jens chose to forsake his soul and became the Vampire's willing slave. As most of his Humanity rotted away, he became a Ghoul, albeit more intelligent and crafty than most of that ilk. Harkon found this useful, and so made Jens his "chancellor." Since then, Harkon has come to rely on Black Jens and even, slightly, trust him.
